name: scan_decimal_number_chars

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:022A
name: scan_decimal_number_restart
description: Same decimal-number scan as its sibling, entered at the top of the character loop after a leading point or sign has been handled. It accumulates digits into a scaled value and writes the result and a success flag through caller-supplied pointers.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0240
name: scan_fraction_and_exponent
description: Consumes the digits after a decimal point and then an optional exponent marker with sign. It advances the digit scale counter, accumulates exponent digits, and stores the outcome through caller pointers.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0252
name: scan_exponent_digits
description: Parses an exponent marker with an optional sign and its following digits, then applies the resulting scale by shifting and adding the accumulated value. It writes the final value and a success flag through pointers in the caller's record.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:02AE
name: normalize_mantissa_and_store
description: Shifts a 64-bit mantissa left until its high bit is set while adjusting an exponent field held in the record. It applies a sign bit and writes the normalized value and a success flag through the caller's pointers.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:02C2
name: normalize_long_mantissa_store
description: Normalizes a 64-bit value by shifting it left and decrementing an exponent field until the top bit is set, then stores the value and a success flag through caller pointers. It differs from its sibling only in the zero-check branch.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:02F0
name: adjust_exponent_until_zero
description: Repeatedly shifts the value and steps the exponent field toward zero, calling a helper for each step, until the field reaches zero. It then stores the final value and a success flag through the caller's pointers.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:030C
name: normalize_exponent_loop
description: Loops over an exponent counter, shifting the value left and calling a helper on each pass until the counter goes negative or reaches zero. On exit it stores the value and a success flag through the caller's pointers.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0316
name: store_helper_result_flag
description: Calls a helper that returns a 64-bit value, stores that value through a pointer held in the record, sets the success flag to one, and returns the value. It does no parsing of its own.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0352
name: read_pending_byte_or_callback
description: Returns a byte already waiting in the record if one is present, clearing it. Otherwise it calls a fetch callback from the record, stores the byte, decrements a remaining count, and sets an end-of-data flag when the count reaches zero.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0362
name: read_byte_through_callback
description: Calls a fetch callback from the record to get one byte, stores it in the caller's buffer position, and decrements a remaining count. When the count reaches zero it sets an end-of-data flag in the record.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:85:0384
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that only returns and performs no work. It is called by one other routine and has no behaviour of its own.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:77:0000
name: compute_signed_magnitude_division
description: Divides the first operand by the second using a 32-iteration restoring division loop on absolute values. It returns zero when either operand is zero, and negates the quotient when the operands have different signs.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:17:0000
name: check_break_signal_and_report
description: Calls the signal-set routine for break-signal bits and returns zero if none are set. If a break is pending and a debug flag is set, it writes a caret, a letter that depends on which break bit was set, and a newline, then calls an output routine for each index up to a counter.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:90:0000
name: open_intuition_and_show_requester
description: Opens the intuition library and stores its handle in a global, then copies a second global value. It shows an automatic requester with a fixed size and then calls a helper with a constant argument.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:0000

description: Skips characters whose class flag marks them as whitespace, optionally consumes an 'l' size modifier, and reads the next character through a callback. key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:00E6

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:0586

description: Identical code to its sibling: checks whether the current character can begin a number, stores non-numeric characters directly, and otherwise calls the number scanner and stores the parsed long or eight-byte value. It returns the advanced position.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:05B8

description: Calls the number scanner, stores the returned value through the record's pointer, and writes a success flag. It returns the advanced position, and it only stores the value when the scan reports success.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:05EC

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:74:0628

description: Writes the current character through the pointer held in the record and returns the advanced position, with no other effect.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:83:0012

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:83:00A6

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:82:0022

description: Shifts a 32-bit value until its leading bit reaches the top, adjusts the exponent with the single-precision bias, and reports status one for a low exponent or two for a high one through a callback.

key: portal (1986)(activision)(disk 2 of 3)/Portal (1986)(Activision)(Disk 2 of 3).adf:prefutmaker:82:0078
